important_notes: This schedule was transcribed from an image shared in an internal group chat; it has not been confirmed as the current schedule or approved for public distribution.
The document is titled Valencia City Health Office (Schedule of Doctors). It does not explicitly establish that every listed assignment takes place at the German Annex.
The image lists weekday assignments but does not specify consultation hours.
Do not present this schedule as current public information until an authorized CHO representative confirms it.

public_sources.description: Reproduced Valencia City Health Office public updates. Identifies Dr. Juniver G. Flores, EMT, MPH; Dr. Mary Claire Ida B. Ricare-Rabago, RN; and Dr. Anito S. Rondina, MD in CHO-related posts.
Reproduced Valencia City Health Office public updates. Identifies Atty. Michael E. Escalante, MD, CGDH I as City Health Officer.

research_limitations: Public web results did not establish the full names and professional credentials of all eight doctors.
The credentials shown here are only those explicitly supported by the located public sources; no additional degrees or licenses have been inferred.
Publicly identifying a person as a CHO employee or physician does not establish that the pictured weekly assignment sheet is current.
